summary: Lucas GC Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that CTO Harry Tang will step down effective July 30, 2026, to become a senior advisor. The change is for personal reasons and not due to any disagreement. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor is named. As a foreign private issuer report, it is equivalent to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 departure announcement. The event appears planned, not abrupt or forced. What to watch: whether further executive departures or strategic shifts follow.
